text: Implemented crash-safe bounded journal compaction with canonical checksummed snapshots plus a bounded forced suffix. Oversized legacy journals promote during bounded open; recovery handles snapshot/old-prefix crash states and replays only newer revisions. Event retention now reports a validated HistoryUnavailable gap, and disk scans serialize with compaction. Added snapshot codec laws and regressions for every publication boundary, read/truncate races, storage bounds, replay-count reduction, additive minor snapshots, corruption, malformed cursor/revision invariants, and stream gap propagation. Independent review findings were repaired and re-reviewed with no major issue remaining. Final full gate passed 554 tests on each Scala lane (3.3.8 and 3.8.4), scalafmt, generated-workflow check, and API docs; the final managed-only cross-version gate also passed 89 tests per lane after strengthening retained-event revision ordering.
